obligations.name: Literal source identity
obligations.statement: Evaluate FourRootAffineCoordinateRing318.Ring branches on the actual PELOriginalContactRootFunctions318.RegularSource through frozen Picard evaluation, not a transported model function field.

obligations.name: Exact realizability inputs
obligations.statement: Use all_roots for every t outside the four literal branches and every tuple satisfying z_i^2=t-branches_i; signed tuples are obtained from Complex.sqrt and checked against the same equations. No generic-field generation or missing numerical j input is assumed.

obligations.name: All sixteen characters
obligations.statement: Mask is Fin 4→Bool; rational ±1 weight orthogonality sums over every mask, including trivial. Complex transport preserves factor16; cancellation also checks each chosen root nonzero.

obligations.name: Coefficient extraction
obligations.statement: Vanishing on all actual signed source tuples implies every polynomial coefficient vanishes at every nonbranch t; polynomial-zero uses complement of finite branch set, not mere finite sampling.

obligations.name: Literal full quotient spanning
obligations.statement: MvPolynomial/Ideal.Quotient induction spans every quotient element by16 squarefree root monomials over Polynomial ℂ through the actual base coordinate algebra action. Rank16 alone and abstract field-degree are not substituted.

obligations.name: Faithful evaluation consumer
obligations.statement: For an arbitrary element in evaluation kernel, use full decomposition, atPoint scalar/root formulas, coefficient separation and zero coefficients. No assertion that the function algebra is a domain is used: full function algebras generally have zero divisors.

obligations.name: Assumptions and scope
obligations.statement: No new mathematical assumption is introduced beyond existing actual analytic source/root producers and their branch distinctness. This proves only a drafted ring-map injectivity statement; it does not imply all original meromorphic functions are generated.

obligations.name: Local and global residuals
obligations.statement: Original branch/infinity faithful local regular-function algebras, sheaf restriction/localization/stalk comparisons, projective algebraization and rational descent are unresolved here. Algebraic local rings must not be identified with all analytic germs. Four ordered published j equalities are not proved.

obligations.name: Evidence and revision discipline
obligations.statement: Source bytes bound above; prior snapshots preserve API corrections. No local Lean or hosted check has run for these drafts. Independent source-only review is not kernel success, production packet acceptance or current-nine-obligation operational acceptance. Each future source change requires new identities/review.
